title: Afghanistan-Pakistan War Tracker Update — Thu Jul 16, 2026
summary: Day 9,048 / Op Ghazab Day 141: after the 33-day strike pause ended June 10, Pakistan and the Taliban exchanged escalating strikes through the month — including Pakistan's largest retaliatory strikes since the pause on June 28-29 (UNAMA: 28 civilians killed, 49 injured) after a June 27 attack on a Karachi Rangers camp, and the Taliban's first-ever direct drone strikes into Pakistani territory on July 1. A wave of TTP and Baloch-militant attacks in Balochistan (July 4-7) prompted Pakistan's Operation Shaban. The UN Security Council renewed UNAMA's mandate for a full year (June 16); journalist Jawid Niazi was released after two months in Taliban custody (July 6); Pakistan's Afghan deportation deadline expired July 10; and OCHA/HRW published new reports on the humanitarian and civilian-casualty toll. A suicide attack was foiled near Wana, South Waziristan today. Backfilled 22 event-days covering June 9-July 16; updated map-lines, map-points, KPIs, casualties, econ, claims, political, strike-targets, retaliation, assets, and meta.
